$comment: Windows-only overrides, merged over tauri.conf.json by the Tauri CLI
following JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). Under RFC 7396 a null VALUE
removes the key, which is the only way to drop an entry from the
resources map on one platform without touching the shared config.
Why speech-assets is removed on Windows: nothing in it can run there.
tts/python is a Mach-O arm64 CPython build (verified: bin/python3 is
Mach-O 64-bit arm64, and the tree holds 5 .dylib and 25 .so files and
ZERO .pyd, so nothing in it is loadable by a Windows interpreter). The
STT engine is absent on every platform - all three whisper-cli rows in
SPEECH-INVENTORY.json are sha256Status: absent - so the 31MB model has
nothing to run it. That left roughly 378MB of payload shipping inside
the NSIS installer that could never execute.
Windows speech is covered instead by the WR-016 system voice, which
uses the System.Speech synthesizer already present on the machine and
needs no bundled assets at all.
UNVERIFIED: there is no Windows machine on this project, so no Windows
bundle has been produced with this file in place. What IS verified is
that it does not affect the macOS build - the CLI only reads the
platform file matching the build target.
